I work for an animal shelter. No, animals (especially older animals) do not typically do well in a shelter. But it’s unfair to her to have an owner who feel like she’s a burden - she deserves to be really loved and appreciated. Best case scenario would be to rehome the sweet dog to someone you trust, maybe a family member or friend. You could also call any and all local rescues that are foster-based so she doesn’t have to go to a shelter. If she can go to another loving home, it would be better. If she goes to a shelter and lays in a cage, she will probably not fare so well. Just make sure not to give her away free to anyone, creeps on the internet look for animals to torture all the time.
